articles.headline: Meet 2026 World Cup debutants: Cape Verde, Curaçao, Jordan, Uzbekistan
articles.description: From soccer to food, experts on each national team to qualify for their first World Cup in 2026 help us get better acquainted with their country.

articles.headline: Marcelo Bielsa: Hydration break 'adds nothing and takes away a lot'
articles.description: Marcelo Bielsa has become the latest figure at the World Cup to criticise hydration breaks, arguing that the rule "adds nothing and takes away a lot."

articles.headline: World Cup Daily: NASA astronauts kick ball around in space; Spain, Belgium in action
articles.description: Another World Cup day, with four more exciting matchups. All eight teams playing today are unbeaten, but all are still looking for their first win.

articles.headline: Daichi Kamada reiterates Japan's goal to win World Cup after record victory
articles.description: After a record-breaking evening for Japan, Daichi Kamada reiterated their target of winning the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

articles.headline: Democratic concepts, authentic storytelling and nostalgia: What makes a good World Cup jersey?
articles.description: There are some incredible designs and colours on display at the 2026 World Cup. So, what makes a World Cup jersey iconic?

articles.headline: Lineker, Shearer, Owen, Rooney, Kane - is England's near half-century of world-class strikers about to end?
articles.description: With an elite striker having worn the Three Lions on their chest for 42 years, England have taken the position for granted - but is Harry Kane the last?
